title: The Clam That Lives in a Sea Urchin's Throat
description: Off southern Australia, scientists found a new clam species living inside a sea urchin's throat. Vaticinaria gulicola grows up to 19 millimeters long and lives four to five thousand meters down. It probably traps food particles from the water current the urchin creates; how the clams find and settle into their urchins is still unknown.
